title: DentRx: an open, guideline-cited dental prescribing reference (antibiotics & analgesics)
description: DentRx encodes published dental prescribing guidance — acute-pain analgesia, infective-endocarditis and prosthetic-joint antibiotic prophylaxis, and therapeutic antibiotics for pulpal/periapical infection — as a tested, versioned, citation-linked dataset with a recommendation engine, a zero-install web app, and a Python package. It spans US (ADA/AHA/AAOS/FDA/AAPD) and UK (SDCEP/NICE/BNF) guidance for adults and children. Educational reference, not a prescription.
